neighbours.label: the word after a verb or noun of variation (vary, differ, between, across) where 'different' or 'each' is expected next
fire: The flowers vary in colour in different parts of the valley.
Accents differ noticeably across the northern and southern towns.
Bird songs vary in pitch in different seasons of the year.
Tax rules differ in important ways between neighbouring states.
Soil acidity varies a great deal across the farm's fields.
The recipes for this soup differ in each village along the coast.
Wolves differ in body size in different climates.
School holidays vary in length between the regions of the country.
quiet: The flowers bloom early in the spring every year.
Accents are easy to hear on the radio in the morning.
Bird songs fill the garden at dawn in the summer.
Tax forms are due at the end of April this year.
Soil was carried away by the heavy rain last night.
The recipe for this soup came from my grandmother.
Wolves hunt in packs during the long winter.
School holidays start next Friday after the exams.
